description.value: Off the Rails Farm Market is a small farm market on Vancouver Island operated by Cameron and JoHanna, rooted in sustainable practices and offering pastured eggs, premium pork products, annuals, perennials, and locally sourced farm goods. The market runs an online WooCommerce shop alongside its physical location at 3125 Piercy Avenue. For touring cyclists, it represents a local farm-direct stop for fresh protein and produce in the Courtenay/Comox Valley area.
